name: test-results
title: Test Results
description: A test run report card that sums the run in pass, fail and skip badges over a green progress bar. Suites expand to list each test, its duration and status, with a red error block for failures.
use: A dev tool or assistant answer needs to report a test run with per-suite detail and failure messages.
avoid: It only displays what you pass in: there is no running, filtering or retry, and error blocks are plain static text.
a11y: Test rows show status only as a coloured icon with no text, so pass and fail depend on colour recognition. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered card headed by three coloured count badges and a duration on the right, over a green progress bar with a small red tail. Below, suites sit in bordered boxes; an open failed one shows test rows, tiny durations and a red error panel with monospace lines.
behaves: Clicking a suite header folds its tests open or shut and rotates a small chevron. Status icons colour each row, pulsing for a running test, while the badges and progress bar stay put at the top.
customise: Summary counts and duration go on the root; suites and tests are composed as children with name, status and duration props. Status colours live in Tailwind classes.
weight: light: Static rows behind collapsible panels and one pulse on running icons.
demo: Checkout, auth and search suites; 21 passed and 2 failed, including a discount test expecting 79.20 but receiving 99.00.
issues: The error stack is tiny dark red monospace on a dark red panel, so it is hard to read.
No single frame shows all three suites open, so the report's full depth never appears at once.
polishWhy: Clear hierarchy and honest status colouring; the error stack text is small and faint on its panel.
